map.注塑成型周期 = 注射 + 保压 + 冷却 + 开模 + 顶出 + 关模: Injection molding cycle = injection + holding + cooling + mould opening + ejection + mould closing
map.注塑成型周期 = 注射 + 保压 + 冷却 + 开模 + 顶出 + 关模。冷却时: Injection molding cycle = injection + holding + cooling + mould opening + ejection + mould closing. Cooling time usually accounts for 50-70% of the total cycle and is the main optimisation target.
map.📚 深度解析：注塑周期与产能: 📚 In-depth analysis: Injection Cycle and Capacity
map.注塑工艺/排产时，把注射+保压+冷却+开模+顶出+关模六段时间相加得到成型总周期: In injection molding process planning and scheduling, add the six stages of injection + holding + cooling + mould opening + ejection + mould closing to get the total molding cycle, then work out the number of shots per hour, daily output and the number of good parts.
map.瓶颈定位时，用周期条形图比较各阶段占比，通常冷却时间占周期大半，是缩短周期的首要: For bottleneck identification, use the cycle bar chart to compare the share of each stage; cooling usually accounts for most of the cycle and is the first target when shortening it.
map.多腔模具核算时，用单件耗时=总周期÷腔数 评估产能，腔数越多单件越快，但需更大锁: For multi-cavity mould accounting, use unit time = total cycle ÷ number of cavities to assess capacity; more cavities make each part faster but require greater clamping force and more balanced runners.
map.六段时间 2/5/15/2/1/2 秒 → 总周期 27 s；每小时注射 360: Six stage times of 2/5/15/2/1/2 seconds → total cycle 27 s; shots per hour = 3600 ÷ 27 ≈ 133.3; with a 4-cavity mould, 20 h of daily operation and a 95% yield → daily output 133.3 × 20 × 4 ≈ 10667 pieces, good parts ≈ 10133; unit time = 27 ÷ 4 = 6.75 s. If cooling drops from 15 s to 10 s the cycle shortens to 22 s and daily output rises by about 23%.
map.冷却时间为什么往往是瓶颈？: Why is cooling time usually the bottleneck?
map.熔体在模内固化占周期大半，冷却不足则顶出变形、需延长。可优化模具水路、降低水温或: Melt solidification inside the mould takes up most of the cycle; insufficient cooling causes ejection deformation and has to be extended. Shorten it by improving mould water channels, lowering water temperature or improving heat conduction — but over-pursuing a short cycle sacrifices appearance and dimensional stability.
map.多腔模具怎么算单件成本？: How is unit cost calculated for a multi-cavity mould?
map.单件耗时 = 总周期÷腔数，腔数翻倍则单件时间减半；但多腔需更大锁模力、更均匀的: Unit time = total cycle ÷ number of cavities, so doubling the cavities halves the unit time; but more cavities need greater clamping force, better runner balance and a higher mould cost, so trade this off against yield and machine capability.
